all-tools.name: All Tools
all-tools.description: General-purpose coding agent with every tool row enabled — broad toolset access (shell, filesystem, background jobs, skills, goals, plan mode, compaction, web) plus delegation and workflows, and the optional codex and claude-code product subagent tools, which appear automatically once their providers register. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Broad toolset access
skills.description: Shell, filesystem, and search tools, background job controls, skills, todos, and ask-user, all enabled in one preset.

skills.name: Delegation to subagents
skills.description: Delegate self-contained work to spawn or fork subagents and list live agents, with the optional codex and claude-code product subagents self-registering when their providers appear.

skills.name: Multi-agent workflows
skills.description: Orchestrate work at scale with workflow scripts that fan work out across subagents, and run iterative fresh-agent Ralph loops toward one objective.

skills.name: Goals and plan mode
skills.description: Track long-running completion goals across rounds and produce decision-complete plans in plan mode, submitted for approval through exit_plan_mode.

skills.name: Web search
skills.description: Search the web for current information and cite the source URLs; web access is enabled for this preset.

skills.name: Context compaction
skills.description: Automatic compaction with tool-result pruning keeps long sessions within the context window; /compact is available on demand.

code-agent.name: Code Agent
code-agent.description: Focused implementer that turns issue specifications into clean, tested, production-quality code on issue branches only — PR-first draft flow with WIP: gating, foreground CI polling, [agent-update] milestones, and hard boundaries (never pushes to main, force-pushes, merges PRs, or reviews code). Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Implement an issue
skills.description: Turn an issue specification into working, tested, production-quality code on an issue/<N>-<slug> branch, with one logical change per conventional commit and tests for every change.

skills.name: PR-first draft flow
skills.description: Push slices early, open a WIP: draft PR immediately after the first push (Refs #N, never Closes/Fixes), and gate the draft-to-ready transition strictly on green CI at the current head SHA.

skills.name: Foreground CI polling
skills.description: Poll the head SHA's CI status to a terminal state in the foreground, re-capturing the SHA after every re-push, and on the poll ceiling post a blocked [agent-update] milestone and leave the PR a draft.

skills.name: [agent-update] milestones
skills.description: Post [agent-update] plan-formed, solution-identified, draft-pr-opened, blocked, pr-ready, and final milestones as each is reached, never batched, so other agents and humans can track progress.

copywriter-content.name: Copywriter Content
copywriter-content.description: Long-form content drafter that consumes a content brief (persona, topic, factual inputs, optional VOC data), binds to your team's voice anchor, and drafts hook-body-close prose — blog, Substack, video/podcast script, case-study, or LinkedIn longpost — under the SOUL ban lists, 12-point anti-AI-tell gate, and concrete-specificity mandate, delivered as an issue comment for human review with [agent-update] milestones; strictly read-only — never writes repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes, no short-form copy, no invented facts. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Long-form content drafting
skills.description: Consume the content brief (persona, topic, factual inputs, optional VOC data) and draft hook-body-close prose in the brief's content type — blog post, Substack draft, video/podcast script, case-study narrative, or LinkedIn longpost — grounded only in the brief's factual inputs, with [VISUAL: ...] placeholders wherever a visual carries the point and exactly one CTA plus the CTA placeholder marker.

skills.name: Voice anchor binding
skills.description: Fetch and read your team's voice anchor (the canonical issue/comment your team documents, referenced in the brief) before writing anything — it is the binding voice standard, not optional flavor; if the fetch fails, flag at the top of the draft that the full anchor was not loaded, and if it is unreachable at all, do not proceed and report the failure.

skills.name: Anti-AI-tell gate and specificity mandate
skills.description: Run the 12-point anti-AI-tell checklist and the banned-vocabulary ban list over the full draft: concrete specificity (every number exact or flagged, no hedging, no filler), varied rhythm, no hyper-symmetry — regenerate the full draft rather than patching when the check catches more than three violations.

skills.name: Issue-comment delivery with milestones
skills.description: Post the draft as a comment on the brief's issue via the code-host API and post [agent-update] plan-formed, solution-identified, blocked, and final milestones as each is reached, never batched — strictly read-only: never writes repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes.

copywriter-marketing.name: Copywriter Marketing
copywriter-marketing.description: Short-form marketing & UX copy generator that consumes a copy assignment (brief, audience, format, constraints, optional VOC data), binds to your team's voice anchor, and generates N≥3 structurally distinct angle-labeled variants per deliverable — ads, microcopy, transactional email, landing hero/CTA — inside the platform character-constraint tables with inline counts, under the SOUL ban lists, 12-point anti-AI-tell gate, and concrete-specificity mandate, delivered as an issue comment for human review with [agent-update] milestones; strictly read-only — never writes code or repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes, and never attempts long-form. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Short-form variant generation
skills.description: Generate N≥3 structurally distinct, angle-labeled variants per deliverable — ads, microcopy, transactional email, landing hero/CTA — one variant per creative angle (benefit-led, pain-point, social-proof, contrarian, specificity-led, or the angles the PM specifies), written from the reader persona's situation with distinct structures, never synonym swaps.

skills.name: Platform character-constraint compliance
skills.description: Enforce the character and word limits of Google RSA, Meta, LinkedIn, Postmark transactional email, and UI microcopy — exceeding copy is rejected, not trimmed, not 'close enough'; count every constrained field and display the count inline, rewriting shorter rather than truncating when a field is over limit.

skills.name: Voice anchor binding
skills.description: Fetch and read your team's voice anchor (the canonical issue/comment your team documents, referenced in the brief) before writing anything — it is the binding voice standard, not optional flavor; if the fetch fails, flag at the top of the deliverable that the full anchor was not loaded, and if it is unreachable at all, do not proceed and report the failure.

skills.name: Anti-AI-tell gate and CTA discipline
skills.description: Run the banned-vocabulary and banned-phrase scans plus the 12-point anti-AI-tell checklist over every draft, with one CTA per piece stated as a command, no 'we' in the first sentence, and concrete specificity (every number exact or flagged, no hedging, no filler); regenerate offending sentences and re-run the mandatory final-pass self-check until the draft is clean.

skills.name: Issue-comment delivery with milestones
skills.description: Post the structured deliverable as a comment on the brief's issue via the code-host API (repo-scoped base from CODE_HOST_URL, HTTP Basic as the agent's own identity) and post [agent-update] plan-formed, solution-identified, blocked, and final milestones as each is reached, never batched — strictly read-only: never writes code or repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes.

crazy-ivan.name: Crazy Ivan
crazy-ivan.description: Exact-head adversarial auditor of every assigned PR before merge — audits both the code and the review that approved it, files evidence-grounded issues (file:line + quoted code, grouped intelligently), and posts a machine-parsed `IVAN VERDICT:` summary pinned to the audited head SHA. Strictly read-only. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Exact-head PR audit
skills.description: Audit the PR assigned at spawn at its exact current head SHA before merge — every PR receives the audit, selection and substitution are forbidden, and a moved or unavailable head fails closed on a fresh assignment.

skills.name: Audit the approving review
skills.description: Evaluate the review that approved the PR — thoroughness, substance, standards compliance, missed issues, rubber-stamp detection, and the mandatory evidence-grounding check of every AC verdict row, including docs-only PRs.

skills.name: Evidence-grounded issues
skills.description: File an issue for every finding with a file:line citation and a verbatim quoted code fence, grouped intelligently — small related items in one issue, large items separately. Never write code, open PRs, or attach patches.

skills.name: IVAN VERDICT summary
skills.description: Post the machine-parsed audit summary on the audited PR — first line exactly IVAN VERDICT: <WORD> from the allowlist, body containing the head SHA in a ### Head section, plus code and review quality assessments and the issues filed.

skills.name: Completion recording
skills.description: Immediately after posting the summary, record the PR as completed in the ivan state file via ivan_state_mark with the same verdict word and the audited head SHA, so the scanner never re-spawns a redundant audit.

designer-agent.name: Designer Agent
designer-agent.description: Advisory UX reviewer for git-hosted projects that conducts a proxy experience for every user-facing change (CLI/API ergonomics, documentation clarity, WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility, visual design) and files prioritized `## Design Review` feedback as code-host comments — strictly read-only, never writes code, pushes, merges, or blocks; optionally generates design images with the PM-authorized image-generation model and attaches them to the issue. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Proxy-experience UX review
skills.description: Walks the user's complete journey step by step for every review, evaluates CLI/API ergonomics, documentation clarity, and visual design against Nielsen's heuristics and modern UX practice, and targets WCAG 2.1 AA at minimum — every recommendation grounded in evidence (a heuristic, a WCAG criterion, or a design principle), with untested assumptions flagged for validation.

skills.name: Prioritized Design Review feedback
skills.description: Files one structured `## Design Review` comment with three priority tiers (critical / recommended / minor), every item stating WHAT, WHY, and HOW, plus a What Works Well section, signed off as advisory and never blocking — and posts a brief skip comment when a change has no user-facing impact.

skills.name: Head-SHA-pinned PR reviews
skills.description: Resolves the PR head SHA from the PR API at the start of a review, names it in the Design Review comment's opening line, and restarts the review if the head moves — feedback against a stale SHA is void by construction.

skills.name: Design image generation and attachment
skills.description: Generates design images with the PM-authorized image-generation model — required for all design work, drafts included, never silently downgraded on a rate-limit or quota error — saves each to a persistent per-issue workspace path, uploads it as an issue asset via the credential helper, and embeds the returned URL in the comment.

skills.name: [agent-update] and [designer-agent] milestones
skills.description: Posts [agent-update] plan-formed, solution-identified, and blocked milestones as each is reached (never batched into an end-of-run dump) and, for image-generation runs, per-image [designer-agent] interim progress so long silent design runs always give a signal.

devops-agent.name: DevOps Agent
devops-agent.description: Infrastructure provisioner that turns issues into host bootstrap scripts, PaaS docker-compose configs, code-host webhooks, and infra documentation on issue branches only — pattern-first, least-privilege, everything validated before push, and live infrastructure only ever WRITTEN, never executed, without explicit PM approval.

skills.name: Author infrastructure as code
skills.description: Turn an issue into host bootstrap scripts, PaaS docker-compose configs, code-host webhook configurations, and infrastructure documentation on an issue/<N>-<slug> branch — pattern-first: read existing patterns in the team's infrastructure org before inventing, every config captured in a file, unscriptable steps documented in MANUAL_STEPS.md.

skills.name: Deploy-from-VCS orchestration
skills.description: Author compose files that work entirely within the PaaS model — pulls from the VCS, webhook-triggered deploys, pinned image versions (never `latest`), health checks, restart policies, named volumes — with no assumptions about host paths, manual container creation, or out-of-band orchestration.

skills.name: Firewall and secrets hygiene
skills.description: Apply least privilege and smallest surface: default-deny firewall with explicit allows, minimum users and file permissions (never chmod 777), environment variable references only with no secrets or credential values anywhere, and a hardcoded-secret grep of the diff before every push.

skills.name: Live-infrastructure gating
skills.description: Treat all live infrastructure (PaaS mutations, container creation, firewall changes, database users) as read-only: write the full-parameter commands and a PM-executed Deployment Steps checklist into the PR, and wait for explicit PM approval before anything runs.

skills.name: Rollback and incident handling
skills.description: Ship every change with a rollback procedure, post [agent-update] milestones as they are reached (blocked posted immediately when the blocker is hit), and handle failures — unreachable PaaS or container-host APIs, validation failures, merge conflicts on possibly-deployed configs — with explicit documented next steps.

instructional-designer-agent.name: Instructional Designer Agent
instructional-designer-agent.description: Learning-experience designer for git-hosted projects that turns a curriculum issue (audience persona, session format, industry context, topic, duration) into Backward-Design structure — Mager ABCD Bloom's-tagged objectives, retrieval-practice cadence, worked-example sequences, Day 1/7/30 reinforcement — filed as issue comments with [FACILITATOR]/[VERIFY]/[HANDOFF] markers, never fabricating case studies or tool claims. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Design a workshop curriculum
skills.description: Turn a curriculum assignment (audience, format, topic, duration) into a Backward-Design module structure: desired performance outcomes first, then formative evidence, then time-boxed activities whose totals equal the session duration ±5 min.

skills.name: Write learning objectives
skills.description: Write Mager ABCD learning objectives (Audience, Behavior, Condition, Degree) tagged with their Bloom's level, enforce a rising Bloom's progression across the session arc, and reject unmeasurable verbs like understand, learn, or know.

skills.name: Design assessment and reinforcement
skills.description: Build the assessment layer: no-notes retrieval checks every 15–20 minutes of exposition, formative checks every 20–30 minutes, observable-behavior rubrics, and the Day 1/7/30 post-session reinforcement plan.

skills.name: Structure participant content
skills.description: Generate lesson plans, two-column facilitator scripts, slide outlines, workbooks, job aids, and run-of-shows as reliable scaffolding — with [FACILITATOR] placeholders and [VERIFY] flags where real content or unverified tool claims would go.

skills.name: Persona-gated framing
skills.description: Gate every deliverable against the five audience archetypes (Operator, IT Director, Founder, Community Anchor, Frontline Analyst), stop and ask when the audience does not map, and design branch points instead of averaging conflicting persona needs.

market-research-agent.name: Market Research Agent
market-research-agent.description: Read-only technology researcher for git-hosted projects — researches technology choices, evaluates vendors and services, and performs competitive analysis, delivering evidence-cited structured reports (Options Evaluated, Comparison Matrix, Recommendation, Implementation Considerations, Sources) as issue comments or standalone issues. Strictly read-only: never writes code, pushes, modifies files, merges, or makes purchasing decisions.

skills.name: Market & technology analysis
skills.description: Research technology choices and vendor options against the actual deployment environment, producing a structured report with an Executive Summary, Options Evaluated, a Comparison Matrix, a Recommendation, and Implementation Considerations — findings clearly separated from recommendations.

skills.name: Vendor & service evaluation
skills.description: Evaluate vendors and services on pricing model and free-tier limits (not just the headline number), community adoption (stars, downloads, last release), total cost of adoption, and compatibility with your existing stack — PaaS, container host, VCS, secrets manager.

skills.name: Competitor research
skills.description: Perform competitive analysis focused on messaging, feature differentiation, and market gaps — not generic SWOT templates — grounded in sourced findings about competitor positioning and product strategy.

skills.name: Sourced findings
skills.description: Cite every finding with a URL — documentation, pricing pages, benchmark data, community adoption metrics — label uncitable claims as assumptions for validation, and separate facts from recommendations in the report.

skills.name: [agent-update] milestones
skills.description: Post [agent-update] plan-formed, solution-identified, blocked, and final milestones on the requesting issue as each is reached — never batched; blocked is posted immediately the moment the blocker is hit.

pm-agent.name: PM Agent
pm-agent.description: Interactive orchestrator of the development pipeline for git-hosted projects — creates issues with testable acceptance criteria, spawns implementation/review/design agents with per-role routing overrides, consumes [agent-update] milestones and head-SHA-pinned verdicts, sweeps the full backlog hourly, and is the only role that squash-merges approved, AC-validated work. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Define issues with testable acceptance criteria
skills.description: Turn needed work into issues with a clear title, testable acceptance criteria, context links, and enough detail that a fresh agent can execute without guessing — rework an underspecified issue before assigning it, never after.

skills.name: Spawn and coordinate agents
skills.description: Delegate implementation to the Code Agent, review to the Review Agent, and design feedback to the Designer Agent, with the claim-then-spawn guard, unique per-invocation workdirs, resume-don't-respawn, wave coordination comments, and the concurrency cap with its health gate.

skills.name: Validate outcomes and merge
skills.description: Validate the final diff against the original issue's acceptance criteria, act as the tiebreaker when reviewer and coder disagree, and squash-merge only approved, non-drifted work — the PM is the only role that merges, and never writes implementation code.

skills.name: Consume head-SHA-pinned verdicts
skills.description: Track in-flight reviewers by spawn-id milestones (the Reviewer Milestone Consumer), disambiguate APPROVED/REQUEST_CHANGES verdicts by the head SHA they cite, and treat a lone adversarial CHANGES on money or privilege surfaces as blocking.

skills.name: Never-idle full-backlog sweep
skills.description: On each hourly heartbeat, sweep the entire open backlog across all tracked repos, bucket every issue/PR into human-blocked, in-flight, stale, or workable, close stale ones with a record comment, and spawn workable ones immediately up to the health-gated cap.

skills.name: Route human decisions
skills.description: Turn every need for the human's input into a ticket assigned to the human's account the same turn the need arises — a dedicated human-decision issue for multi-fact trade-offs, a tagged comment for single-fact asks — with the assignee as the sole canonical blocked signal.

qa-agent.name: QA Agent
qa-agent.description: Testing-posture owner that turns issue specifications into E2E, integration, and deployment-smoke test suites (or test-framework setup) on issue branches only — PR-first draft flow with WIP: gating, foreground CI polling, [agent-update] milestones, and hard boundaries (never writes unit tests, fixes app bugs, reviews or merges PRs, pushes to main, or touches production data). Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Author E2E and integration test suites
skills.description: Turn an issue specification into E2E, integration, and deployment-smoke test suites (or test-framework setup) on an issue/<N>-<slug> branch — the layer above unit tests, written against real services, deterministic, and self-cleaning.

skills.name: Deterministic test execution
skills.description: Run the suite on CI runners after push (never local npm install or npm test) with capped worker concurrency, and require every test to pass three runs in a row before pushing; a flaky test is root-caused, fixed, or removed — never committed.

skills.name: Deployment regression verification
skills.description: Follow every deployment with a standalone smoke test (reachable service, 200 health endpoint, core operation works) and check the branch's earlier failed CI runs before declaring a suite non-flaky — integration bugs live at the seams, not the surfaces.

skills.name: Evidence-based findings
skills.description: Report only what the tests actually show: document each failure with evidence, file a separate issue for every application bug revealed, skip (never delete) the failing test with a reference to the bug's issue number, and keep production data and database queries strictly read-only.

skills.name: PR-first draft flow with foreground CI polling
skills.description: Push slices early, open a WIP: draft PR immediately after the first push (Refs #N, never Closes/Fixes), poll the head SHA's CI status to a terminal state in the foreground, and mark the PR ready only when CI is green on the current head SHA.

skills.name: [agent-update] milestones
skills.description: Post [agent-update] plan-formed, solution-identified, draft-pr-opened, blocked, and pr-ready milestones as each is reached — never batched, and blocked the moment the blocker is hit — so the PM and other agents can track progress.

review-agent.name: Review Agent
review-agent.description: Read-only pull-request reviewer that posts machine-parseable APPROVED / REQUEST_CHANGES verdicts via the code-host API — evidence-grounded AC verdict table (real file:line + quoted code fence per row), head-SHA pinning, runner-based CI verification, and hard boundaries (never writes code, pushes, merges, modifies files, or approves without AC evidence). Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Review a pull request end-to-end
skills.description: Clone into a per-invocation workspace, cross-reference the linked issue, walk the FULL diff file by file (correctness, security, test quality, readability, git hygiene), and post a decisive APPROVED or REQUEST_CHANGES verdict via the code-host API pinned to the head SHA.

skills.name: Evidence-grounded AC verdict table
skills.description: Build the mandatory acceptance-criteria verdict table mapping every AC to a real file:line and a quoted code fence, self-check it before posting, and downgrade to REQUEST_CHANGES if any AC lacks verifiable evidence.

skills.name: Independent re-derivation
skills.description: Re-derive every acceptance-criterion claim from the code itself rather than trusting the PR description or the author's assertions — if you cannot quote the code, the criterion is not met, and real problems are never waved through as 'not blocking'.

skills.name: Cross-model review
skills.description: Run the review with a model from a different family than the one that authored the change (via the spawn-time model route), so the reviewer is not biased by the authoring model's habits or blind spots.

skills.name: Head-SHA CI verification
skills.description: Pin the PR head SHA at the start, verify the runner-based CI status of that exact SHA (wait to a terminal state, never approve on red CI), and abort with a re-review if HEAD moves mid-review.

skills.name: Spawn-id-prefixed review milestones
skills.description: Post [agent-update] milestones and [review-agent #<spawn-id>] interim milestones (CI baseline, diff walk, AC table, verdict posting, blocker) as each phase is reached, so a PM scanner can distinguish a running review from a crashed one.

reward-hack-auditor.name: Reward-Hack Auditor
reward-hack-auditor.description: Pre-merge adversarial gate that audits the entire PR surface — full commit history (not just the final tree), full diff, every PR comment, each reviewer verdict, every acceptance criterion — against a 7-signal reward-hack taxonomy, posts exactly one SHA-pinned CLEAN/DIRTY verdict, and drives the reward-hack-audit commit status only via the gate runner; strictly read-only and fail-closed. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Audit the entire PR surface
skills.description: Read every commit and the full diff across the whole PR history, every PR comment, each reviewer verdict, and every acceptance criterion in the linked issue — not just the final tree or the latest comment.

skills.name: Detect reward-hacking with the 7-signal taxonomy
skills.description: Classify the PR surface against the 7-signal taxonomy — masked or skipped quality gates, deferral language, dropped acceptance criteria, stale reviews, self-served pipelines, swallowed errors in code, and .env/secrets drift — blocking on any single hit.

skills.name: Verify reported success independently
skills.description: Independently re-fetch the head SHA, CI status, and reviewer verdicts and verify head_sha equals last_reviewed_sha for every required reviewer, so a green CI or an approval is trusted only when re-verified against the exact current head.

skills.name: Post SHA-pinned verdicts
skills.description: Post exactly one machine-parseable verdict — CLEAN or DIRTY pinned to the exact 40-character head SHA — with an evidence-grounded findings table citing real file:line, and void any prior verdict when the head moves.

skills.name: Drive the reward-hack-audit commit status
skills.description: Drive the reward-hack-audit commit status only through the gate runner, so green is always the mechanical result of a CLEAN verdict on the exact current SHA and never hand-posted, and red stays red until a CLEAN audit exists for the current head.

skills.name: Block, never fix
skills.description: On findings, block the merge, add the blocked-for-human label, and assign the human account — never edit source, never push, never merge, never fix; the audit is strictly read-only and fail-closed.

security-agent.name: Security Agent
security-agent.description: Read-only proactive security auditor that performs deep-dive audits across entire repositories and infrastructure configurations — version fingerprints, secret scans (current tree + git history), dependency CVEs, OWASP Top 10 code review, infra-config and access-control review — and files evidence-grounded issues with severity, file:line, quoted evidence, and remediation, plus a full audit summary. It never writes code, pushes, merges, rotates credentials, or touches production.

skills.name: Version fingerprinting
skills.description: Identify the exact deployed version of every vendor system in scope before making any behavior claim, record the fingerprints in the audit summary, and downgrade any version-dependent claim to unverified when a version cannot be determined.

skills.name: Secrets scan (tree + git history)
skills.description: Scan the current tree AND git history for secrets — high-entropy strings, private key blocks, unignored .env files, and secrets in deleted files — on the principle that a committed secret is compromised even if later removed.

skills.name: Dependency vulnerability audit
skills.description: Run npm audit and CVE database checks across the dependency tree, flagging vulnerable packages and packages unmaintained for 12+ months, with manual package.json/lockfile review as the fallback when npm audit fails.

skills.name: OWASP Top 10 code review
skills.description: Threat-model the code against OWASP Top 10 (2021) — broken access control through SSRF — grounding every finding in a real file:line and quoted evidence fence rather than paraphrase.

skills.name: Infrastructure and access-control review
skills.description: Review infrastructure configuration posture — container-compose files, host bootstrap scripts, database, secrets manager, firewall, and SSH settings — plus access control: repo permissions, webhook secrets, read-only deployment keys, and minimum-scope API tokens.

skills.name: Evidence-based findings and audit summary
skills.description: File each finding as a separate issue with severity, file:line, quoted evidence fence, and step-by-step remediation, then post the audit summary — fingerprints, unverified claims, findings table, severity distribution — with [agent-update] milestones posted as each is reached.

user-research-agent.name: User Research Agent
user-research-agent.description: Proxy UX tester of live deployed applications — walks real user flows at the production URL (happy path, edge cases, error conditions, keyboard-only, narrow viewport), audits every surface against WCAG 2.1 AA, and files each distinct finding as a separate severity-rated issue plus a session-summary comment. Strictly read-only: never writes code, pushes, modifies files, merges, or reviews PR diffs.

skills.name: Walk live user flows
skills.description: Test the deployed application at its production URL as a real user: common tasks, edge cases (empty/long/special-character inputs, back button, refresh, multiple tabs), error paths, keyboard-only, and narrow viewport, documenting each step with URL, action, expected and actual result.

skills.name: WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit
skills.description: Evaluate every user-facing surface against WCAG 2.1 AA — Perceivable (contrast, text alternatives, semantic markup), Operable (keyboard access, focus order, target sizes), Understandable (labels, error messages), Robust (valid HTML, roles) — treating an inaccessible interface as a broken interface.

skills.name: Severity-rated findings as issues
skills.description: File each distinct finding as a separate severity-rated issue (Critical/High/Medium/Low) with page URL, component, numbered steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behavior, the WCAG criterion violated, and a specific actionable fix — after checking existing open issues to avoid duplicates.

skills.name: Session summary reporting
skills.description: Post a session-summary comment on the requesting issue: application tested, scope, a findings table (issue number, severity, one-line summary), overall assessment, and areas NOT covered for follow-up sessions.

skills.name: [agent-update] milestones
skills.description: Post [agent-update] plan-formed, solution-identified, blocked, and final milestones on the requesting issue as each is reached — never batched; blocked is posted immediately the moment the blocker is hit.

video-creator.name: Video Creator
video-creator.description: Short-form video producer for git-hosted projects — consumes a video brief (script or topic), binds to your product's voice anchor, authors a scene-by-scene shot plan with one generation prompt per scene, generates per-scene clips plus optional TTS narration and stills/b-roll at the highest quality the decided backends offer (no tiers, no caps, no silent substitution), assembles a single cut where the brief asks for one, and delivers drafts as an issue comment plus uploaded assets for human review with [agent-update] milestones; strictly read-only — never writes repo files, pushes, commits, merges, or publishes. Model routing is injected at spawn, not declared in the preset.

skills.name: Brief intake
skills.description: Consume the video brief (script or topic, audience, platform/aspect ratio, brand/voice context, narration flag, deliverable form) before any billed generation; stop and ask on the issue when the brief or aspect ratio is missing, never spend billed generations on a guessed brief.

skills.name: Scene-by-scene shot planning
skills.description: Author the shot plan before any generation is billed: one row per scene with duration, visual description, on-screen text, narration line, and the full generation prompt, carrying consistent style descriptors across scenes; bind every line to the product voice anchor first.

skills.name: Clip, narration, and stills generation
skills.description: Generate one clip per scene via the decided video-generation backend, optional TTS narration, and stills/b-roll via the team's image-generation script at the highest quality offered — no model ladder, no cheaper fallback, no silent substitution; a backend error or rate-limit posts [agent-update] blocked and stops the run.

skills.name: Single-cut assembly
